**Publish gate report**

**Going out:** Search ad (headline plus description) for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. No date was given.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** All three factual claims are on the policy's allowlist.
  - "Monthly loose leaf tea" is a product fact.
  - "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" is on the list.
  - "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" is on the list, and the £25 condition is stated.
  - There are no invented stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials or urgency claims.
- **Regulated claims:** The only touchpoint is the delivery offer. It is accurate to policy and has no fake deadline or "was" price, so it passes.
- **House style:** Plain, specific and free of AI tells or banned phrasing. No changes needed.
- **Disclosure:** This is the brand's own search ad, and the ad platform adds its own "Ad" or "Sponsored" label. There is no creator, affiliate or AI-generated element, so nothing extra is needed in the copy.

**Fixed:** Nothing, no changes were needed.

**Needs a decision**
- **Description length:** The description is about 102 characters. Many search ad formats, including Google responsive search ads, cap descriptions at 90. If this is going to such a platform, drop one sentence or trim it, for example "Monthly loose leaf tea. Pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery over £25." I haven't changed it because the channel limit isn't in the policy.
- **Landing page:** The ad can't promise anything the linked page doesn't back up. Please confirm the page shows the pause/cancel terms and the £25 free delivery threshold.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on this exact copy. If you change the description for length, that counts as new content and gets a quick re-check. I haven't recorded any approval.
